from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):

        PARABOLA_COLOR = "#FFA500"

        CONE_COLOR = BLUE_D

        # Right-side visualization center
        center_pt = (self.grid["A1"] + self.grid["F6"]) / 2
        v = center_pt # Vertex for the cone

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Representing an ellipse configuration
        self.lecture[0].set_color(ELLIPSE_COLOR)
        
        # Upper Cone Sides
        l1 = Line(v, v + 2.2 * rotate_vector(UP, 30*DEGREES), color=CONE_COLOR)
        l2 = Line(v, v + 2.2 * rotate_vector(UP, -30*DEGREES), color=CONE_COLOR)

        plane = Line(LEFT*1.2, RIGHT*1.2, color=ELLIPSE_COLOR)

        s2 = Circle(radius=0.55, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to(v + UP * 1.8)
        
        self.play(Create(upper_cone), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(plane), run_time=1)
        self.play(FadeIn(s1), FadeIn(s2), run_time=1)
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===

            FadeOut(s2),
            run_time=2.5
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Transition to Hyperbola: Tilt plane further (vertical) and show double cone
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(HYPERBOLA_COLOR)
        
        # Lower Cone Sides
        l3 = Line(v, v + 2.2 * rotate_vector(DOWN, 30*DEGREES), color=CONE_COLOR)
        l4 = Line(v, v + 2.2 * rotate_vector(DOWN, -30*DEGREES), color=CONE_COLOR)
        lower_cone = VGroup(l3, l4)
        
        self.play(Create(lower_cone), run_time=1.5)
        
        # Rotate plane to vertical and position two spheres
        self.play(
            plane.animate.set_color(HYPERBOLA_COLOR).set_angle(90*DEGREES).move_to(v),
            s1.animate.scale(0.7).move_to(v + UP*0.7),
            run_time=2.5
        )
        # Bring back/adjust sphere 2 in the lower nappe
        s2.move_to(v + DOWN*0.7).scale(0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(s2), run_time=1)
